subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to inform you that your flight booking from New York to London on July 15th has been successfully confirmed. Your itinerary details are attached to this email for your reference. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. Safe travels! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
